remainingGaps: Single-integer page ranges only; full range syntax stays open.
Default IDs are deterministic content hashes (no ambient clock), unlike upstream time-based random IDs; documented intentional difference. Oracle ID comparison needs normalization.
Object-stream disabling for forced versions below 1.5 is vacuous until 22b generates streams; no other feature downgrading is claimed.
Object-stream interaction for forced versions below 1.5 awaits work item 22b; extension levels beyond catalog ADBE emission need oracle comparison.
Classic-xref streams only; object/xref-stream interactions await 22b.

Object-stream payloads and xref entries are emitted uncompressed (no Flate/predictor); Flate packing arrives with compression controls (item 23). Preserve keeps compressed-ness, not exact original groupings.
Accepted no-op: outputs never carry source labels unless set.
No backup files are made; failed publications leave targets untouched.
Range forms rN, :odd, :even, and x-groups stay unsupported.
Typed single-page rotation overloads are open; use the multi-source API.
Source page-label trees are dropped, never merged (number-tree reading is later work).
Prefix text is stored as UTF-8 bytes.
Typed callers split by looping single-output selections.
Matches upstream test constant and original-ID preservation; static wins when both ID flags are given.
